name: Create Spreadsheet/Tab
plugin_description: Integrates with Google Sheets to read, search, and write rows from Kizen agentic workflows.
action_description: Creates a brand-new spreadsheet, optionally with a header row. Creating from a template is not yet supported — see hint.

inputs.name: template_spreadsheet_id
inputs.label: Template Spreadsheet ID
inputs.hint: NOT YET SUPPORTED. Copying from a template needs a Google Drive API scope this plugin doesn't have, and whether drive.file is even sufficient hasn't been confirmed (see CLAUDE.md). Leave blank; providing a value raises a clear error instead of silently being ignored.

inputs.name: header_row_values
inputs.label: Header Row Values
inputs.hint: JSON array string of header names to write into row 1 of the new sheet, e.g. ["Name", "Email"]. Leave blank to create an empty sheet.

inputs.name: folder_id
inputs.label: Folder ID
inputs.hint: Google Drive folder ID to place the new spreadsheet in (from the folder's URL: .../folders/{folder_id}). Leave blank to create it in My Drive's root, same as the Sheets API's own default. Requires the drive.file scope.

outputs.name: sheet_name
outputs.label: Sheet Name
outputs.hint: The new sheet's first tab name (Google's own default, e.g. Sheet1, since no input lets you choose it).
